name: LINCS L1000 / CMap (2017 release)
modality_en: bulk L1000 profiles (978 landmark genes measured; other genes inferred, per MD03)
modality_zh: bulk L1000 谱（测量 978 个标志基因，其余基因为推断，依据 MD03）
scale_reported_en: 1,319,138 profiles (DS01, DS03); secondary description: about 19,811 compounds x about 70 cell lines (DS04)
scale_reported_zh: 1,319,138 条谱（DS01、DS03）；二手描述：约 19,811 种化合物 × 约 70 个细胞系（DS04）
perturbation_type_en: small molecules; genetic knockdown and overexpression (secondary, DS04)
perturbation_type_zh: 小分子；基因敲低和过表达（二手，DS04）
genotype_info_en: cell-line identity only; no donor genotype retrieved
genotype_info_zh: 仅有细胞系身份；未取得供体基因型
relevance_en: B track: drug-response context across cell lines; in about 600 drug-cell-line pairs, cell-type specificity depended on drug class (GD41)
relevance_zh: B 轨道：跨细胞系的药物响应背景；在约 600 个药物–细胞系对中，细胞类型特异性取决于药物类别（GD41）
caveats_en: Exact cell-line count of the 2017 release was not found; compound and cell-line counts are secondary.
caveats_zh: 未找到 2017 年版本的确切细胞系数；化合物与细胞系数量为二手信息。

name: LINCS2 beta (secondary description)
scale_reported_en: more than 80k perturbations; more than 200 cell lines; more than 3 million profiles (secondary)
scale_reported_zh: 超过 80k（8 万）个扰动；超过 200 个细胞系；超过 3 million（300 万）条谱（二手）
relevance_en: B track: possible larger successor to L1000
relevance_zh: B 轨道：L1000 可能更大的后继数据集
caveats_en: Known only from a Bioconductor package description; verify at the data provider.
caveats_zh: 仅见于 Bioconductor 软件包的描述；需在数据提供方核实。

name: Tahoe-100M
scale_reported_en: about 100 million cells; 50 cancer cell lines; about 1,100 drug-dose conditions (other sources: 379 drugs / 25 mechanisms / 52,886 cell-line-drug conditions; 1,200 perturbations)
scale_reported_zh: 约 100 million（1 亿）个细胞；50 个癌细胞系；约 1,100 个药物剂量条件（其他来源：379 种药物 / 25 种作用机制 / 52,886 个细胞系–药物条件；1,200 个扰动）
perturbation_type_zh: 多个剂量下的小分子药物
genotype_info_en: cell-line identity assigned by SNP-based deconvolution of pooled cell villages
genotype_info_zh: 细胞系身份由对混池细胞村落基于 SNP 的解卷积得到
dose_time_axes_zh: 剂量：药物剂量条件；时间：NA
relevance_en: S track backbone: context-dependent drug response; cell-line identity, not batch, dominates clustering
relevance_zh: S 轨道骨干：依赖背景的药物响应；主导聚类的是细胞系身份而不是批次
caveats_en: Condition counts differ between sources; profiles retain proliferation, cytotoxicity and cell-cycle signals, so composition effects must be handled.
caveats_zh: 各来源给出的条件数不一致；谱中保留增殖、细胞毒性和细胞周期信号，必须处理细胞构成效应。

name: Genome-scale Perturb-seq in primary human CD4+ T cells
scale_reported_en: about 22 million cells; 4 donors; all expressed genes perturbed
scale_reported_zh: 约 22 million（2,200 万）个细胞；4 名供体；所有表达的基因都被扰动
perturbation_type_en: genetic perturbation of all expressed genes
perturbation_type_zh: 对所有表达基因的遗传扰动
relevance_en: G/B track: donor-level variation could be probed, but no donor-by-perturbation analysis was seen in the excerpt
relevance_zh: G/B 轨道：可以探查供体层面的变异，但在摘录中未见供体×扰动的分析
caveats_en: The URL is the paper, not a data portal; data access was not checked.
caveats_zh: 该 URL 是论文而不是数据门户；数据获取方式未核查。

name: Perturbation cell atlas of human iPSCs (KOLF2.1J)
scale_reported_en: NA
scale_reported_zh: NA
relevance_en: B track: baseline for iPSC Perturb-seq; one genotype, so it cannot test genotype dependence
relevance_zh: B 轨道：iPSC Perturb-seq 的基线；只有一个基因型，因此无法检验基因型依赖性
caveats_en: Scale not retrieved; the URL is the paper.
caveats_zh: 规模未取得；该 URL 是论文。

name: Anthracycline response-QTL dataset (iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes)
scale_reported_en: 45 individuals; 376 reQTLs; 42 response sQTLs
scale_reported_zh: 45 名个体；376 个 reQTL；42 个响应 sQTL
genotype_info_en: individual-level genotypes implied by QTL mapping; availability not checked
genotype_info_zh: QTL 定位意味着有个体层面的基因型；可获得性未核查
relevance_en: G track: positive control for response-QTL work; the only study retrieved that links in-vitro response to in-vivo cardiotoxicity risk
relevance_zh: G 轨道：响应 QTL 工作的阳性对照；检索到的唯一把体外响应与体内心脏毒性风险联系起来的研究
caveats_en: Only 45 individuals; data availability to be checked.
caveats_zh: 仅 45 人；数据可得性待核。

name: Hepatocyte response-QTL study (African American donors)
modality_zh: 基因表达（检测方法未取得）
scale_reported_en: 2,988 reQTLs; donor and drug counts not retrieved
scale_reported_zh: 2,988 个 reQTL；供体数和药物数未取得
relevance_en: G track: drug-perturbed reQTLs; best-known example involves CYP3A5, a PK gene (judgment J8)
relevance_zh: G 轨道：药物扰动的 reQTL；最著名的例子涉及 PK 基因 CYP3A5（判断 J8）
caveats_en: The URL is the paper; data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 该 URL 是论文；数据获取方式未核查。

name: Glucocorticoid-treated lymphoblastoid lines
scale_reported_en: 114 EBV-transformed B-cell lines; 26 genes with genotype-by-treatment interactions
scale_reported_zh: 114 个 EBV 转化的 B 细胞系；26 个基因存在基因型×处理交互
genotype_info_en: cell-line genotypes; African and European ancestry
genotype_info_zh: 细胞系基因型；非洲和欧洲祖源
relevance_en: G track: classic gene-by-treatment design
relevance_zh: G 轨道：经典的基因×处理设计
caveats_en: The URL is the paper; data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 该 URL 是论文；数据获取方式未核查。

name: iPSC endoderm-differentiation sc-eQTL (125 lines)
scale_reported_en: 125 iPSC lines; 4 time points; about 899 time-dynamic eQTLs (secondary)
scale_reported_zh: 125 株 iPSC；4 个时间点；约 899 个时间动态 eQTL（二手）
genotype_info_zh: 125 株来源于供体的细胞系
relevance_en: G track: shows dynamic genetic effects; contains no drug
relevance_zh: G 轨道：显示动态遗传效应；不含药物
caveats_en: The eQTL count is from a secondary summary.
caveats_zh: eQTL 数量来自二手总结。

name: Geuvadis (lymphoblastoid RNA-seq plus whole-genome data)
scale_reported_en: 421 individuals
scale_reported_zh: 421 名个体
relevance_en: G track: benchmark for personal expression prediction by sequence models
relevance_zh: G 轨道：序列模型预测个体表达的基准
caveats_en: Access route not retrieved.
caveats_zh: 获取途径未取得。

caveats_en: Size and access route not retrieved.
caveats_zh: 规模与获取途径未取得。

relevance_zh: G 轨道：细胞类型分辨的 eQTL

caveats_zh: 规模未取得；586% 的提升为二手数字。

name: DepMap, GDSC and PRISM (cell-line omics and drug sensitivity)
modality_en: cell-line expression and mutation features plus drug sensitivity (viability)
modality_zh: 细胞系表达和突变特征加药物敏感性（活力）
scale_reported_en: NA
scale_reported_zh: NA
genotype_info_zh: 细胞系层面的突变特征
relevance_en: S track annotation backbone for mutation-by-drug questions
relevance_zh: S 轨道：突变×药物问题的注释骨干
caveats_en: Targets are viability and gene dependency, not transcriptomes; cross-dataset agreement is reportedly low (F18 item b, unverified).
caveats_zh: 目标是活力和基因依赖性，而不是转录组；据称跨数据集一致性较低（F18 的 b 项，未核验）。

name: Virtual Cell Challenge 2026 CRISPRi cell-line datasets
scale_reported_en: 6 CRISPRi cancer cell lines (3 validation, 3 test); about 300 target genes; 400 cells per perturbation x 18,533 genes (third-party description)
scale_reported_zh: 6 个 CRISPRi 癌细胞系（3 个验证、3 个测试）；约 300 个靶基因；每个扰动 400 个细胞 × 18,533 个基因（第三方描述）
relevance_en: B track: zero-shot cross-context benchmark
relevance_zh: B 轨道：零样本跨背景基准
caveats_en: Details come from a third-party repository; check the official site, including the reported 22 Oct and 5 Nov 2026 dates.
caveats_zh: 细节来自第三方仓库；请在官网核实，包括所报告的 2026 年 10 月 22 日和 11 月 5 日。

name: Virtual Cell Challenge 2025 H1 hESC genetic-perturbation benchmark
scale_reported_en: NA
scale_reported_zh: NA
relevance_en: B track: within-context benchmark used by Lingshu-Cell (self-reported lead)
relevance_zh: B 轨道：Lingshu-Cell 使用的情境内基准（自报领先）
caveats_en: Details not retrieved; the search summary mentions Tahoe-100M, K562 and A375 as other cell-line datasets.
caveats_zh: 细节未取得；检索摘要把 Tahoe-100M、K562 和 A375 提作其他细胞系数据集。

name: sci-Plex3 (used to train PRnet)
scale_reported_en: 188 compounds; 3 cancer cell lines (MCF7, K562, A549); about 650,000 cells; 5,000 samples
dose_time_axes_zh: 剂量：剂量依赖响应；时间：NA
relevance_en: B track: single-cell chemical-perturbation data used alongside L1000
relevance_zh: B 轨道：与 L1000 并用的单细胞化学扰动数据
caveats_en: Known only through the PRnet paper; scale not retrieved. Scale from the sci-Plex paper (DS15); substantial intercellular heterogeneity of response is reported.
caveats_zh: 仅通过 PRnet 论文得知；规模未取得。 规模来自 sci-Plex 论文（DS15）；论文报告响应存在显著的细胞间异质性。

name: Perturbation panel profiling (P3) in iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes
scale_reported_en: 75 perturbation conditions (triplicate or vehicle control)
scale_reported_zh: 75 种扰动条件（三个重复或溶剂对照）
perturbation_type_zh: NA（75 种条件；类型未取得）
relevance_en: B track: panel design precedent, but one genotype
relevance_zh: B 轨道：面板设计的先例，但只有一个基因型
caveats_en: The URL is the paper; data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 该 URL 是论文；数据获取方式未核查。

name: Yeast CRISPRi across 169 segregants
scale_reported_en: 169 segregants; 460 genes with background-dependent effects; 234 interacting loci; 4 hub loci
scale_reported_zh: 169 个分离子；460 个基因的效应依赖遗传背景；234 个交互位点；4 个枢纽位点
genotype_info_zh: 来自自然变异的分离子基因型
relevance_en: Design analogue for genotype-by-perturbation interaction; not human
relevance_zh: 基因型×扰动交互的设计类比；不是人类
caveats_en: Yeast; transfer to human cells is untested.
caveats_zh: 酵母；向人类细胞的迁移未经检验。

name: Base-editing plus Perturb-seq of cancer drug-resistance variants (HT-29)
scale_reported_en: 11 cancer genes
scale_reported_zh: 11 个癌症基因
perturbation_type_en: base-edited variants under dabrafenib or cetuximab
perturbation_type_zh: 在 dabrafenib 或 cetuximab 处理下的碱基编辑变异
genotype_info_en: engineered variants in one cell line (HT-29)
genotype_info_zh: 一个细胞系（HT-29）中的工程化变异
relevance_en: S track: variant-to-transcriptome readout under drug
relevance_zh: S 轨道：药物下变异到转录组的读出
caveats_en: The URL is the paper; data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 该 URL 是论文；数据获取方式未核查。

name: Perturb-seq of TP53 and KRAS coding variants
scale_reported_en: NA
scale_reported_zh: NA
perturbation_type_zh: 编码变异（递送方式未取得）
genotype_info_en: engineered coding variants in A549 cells (from a search summary)
genotype_info_zh: A549 细胞中的工程化编码变异（来自检索摘要）
relevance_en: S track: coding-variant readout at transcriptome level
relevance_zh: S 轨道：转录组层面的编码变异读出
caveats_en: Scale not retrieved; no drug arm reported in the excerpt. A search summary reports a functional gradient of cell states rather than a binary effect (see GD26).
caveats_zh: 规模未取得；摘录中未见药物处理组。 检索摘要报告的是细胞状态的功能梯度，而不是二元效应（见 GD26）。

name: Parse 10 Million PBMC cytokine atlas
scale_reported_en: 9,697,974 cells; 18 cell types; 12 donors; 90 cytokines or PBS; 24 hours; about 7,400 cells per condition
scale_reported_zh: 9,697,974 个细胞；18 种细胞类型；12 名供体；90 种细胞因子或 PBS；24 小时；每个条件约 7,400 个细胞

genotype_info_zh: 有供体；检索到的文字未说明是否做了基因分型

relevance_zh: G/B 轨道：最大的供体×扰动单细胞网格；未见供体泛化和中介消融的测试平台
caveats_en: Commercial licence terms apply, with a Hugging Face copy; whether the donors are genotyped is not stated.
caveats_zh: 适用商业许可条款，另有 Hugging Face 副本；未说明供体是否做了基因分型。

name: OP3 PBMC chemical perturbation set (GSE279945)
modality_zh: PBMC 中的单细胞多模态谱
scale_reported_en: 146 chemical perturbations; 3 donors; T, B, NK and myeloid cells (the earlier competition release had 144 compounds)
scale_reported_zh: 146 种化学扰动；3 名供体；T、B、NK 和髓系细胞（较早的竞赛版本有 144 种化合物）
genotype_info_zh: 仅有供体身份（3 名供体）

relevance_zh: G/B 轨道：供体数少、细胞类型多的化学网格，用于未见细胞类型的检验

caveats_zh: 未描述留出供体的评测；该 URL 是 GEO 系列在 OmicsDI 中的记录。

name: X-Atlas/Orion genome-wide Perturb-seq
modality_zh: 单细胞 Perturb-seq（固定–冷冻保存平台）
scale_reported_en: about 8 million cells in HCT116 and HEK293T (one post says 8.4 million); median 16,000 UMIs per cell; median on-target knockdown 75.4% (HCT116) and 51.5% (HEK293T)
scale_reported_zh: HCT116 和 HEK293T 中约 8 million（800 万）个细胞（一则帖子称 8.4 million，即 840 万）；每个细胞中位数 16,000 个 UMI；中位靶向敲低 75.4%（HCT116）和 51.5%（HEK293T）
perturbation_type_en: genome-wide CRISPR targeting all human protein-coding genes
perturbation_type_zh: 靶向所有人类蛋白编码基因的全基因组 CRISPR

dose_time_axes_zh: 剂量：梯度的敲低效率；时间：NA

relevance_zh: B 轨道：梯度敲低是亚效等位基因最接近的公开代理
caveats_en: Cell counts differ between sources; the dataset card was seen only in a search result.
caveats_zh: 各来源给出的细胞数不一致；数据集卡片只在检索结果中见到。

name: Genome-scale CRISPRi Perturb-seq in K562 and RPE1
scale_reported_en: more than 2.5 million cells; K562 screen covers all expressed genes and RPE1 covers essential genes; median knockdown 85.5% (K562) and 91.6% (RPE1)
scale_reported_zh: 超过 2.5 million（250 万）个细胞；K562 筛选覆盖所有表达基因，RPE1 覆盖必需基因；中位敲低 85.5%（K562）和 91.6%（RPE1）
relevance_en: B track: reference for pretraining gene-loss effects and calibrating effect sizes; stands in for loss-of-function variants when no drug is present
relevance_zh: B 轨道：用于预训练基因缺失效应并校准效应大小的参考；在没有药物时可代理功能缺失变异
caveats_en: Processed data are said to be on Figshare+, but no link was retrieved; the URL is the paper.
caveats_zh: 据称处理后的数据在 Figshare+ 上，但未取回链接；该 URL 是论文。

name: scPerturb harmonized collection
modality_zh: 单细胞扰动数据集（已协调）
scale_reported_en: 44 public datasets
scale_reported_zh: 44 个公开数据集

perturbation_type_zh: 因数据集而异；取回的文字中未逐项列出

caveats_zh: 据检索到的文字，有一个 Python 包发布在 PyPI 上；数据获取路径未核查。

scale_reported_en: NA
scale_reported_zh: NA

perturbation_type_zh: 短暂与持续的神经元激活；胚胎干细胞中的一种遗传扰动（据摘要）
dose_time_axes_en: dose: NA; time: minutes versus hours of stimulation, new versus old RNA

relevance_zh: B 轨道：发现的、能从快照中识别状态更新动力学的途径

caveats_zh: 方法论文；规模和数据获取方式未取得。

name: Well-TEMP-seq time-resolved single-cell RNA profiles
modality_en: single-cell RNA-seq with metabolic labeling in microwells
modality_zh: 在微孔中带代谢标记的单细胞 RNA-seq

relevance_zh: B 轨道：时间分辨 scRNA-seq 的药物暴露示例，可提供转移目标

caveats_zh: 规模和数据获取方式未取得。

name: LabCompass loop data (Hugging Face)

modality_zh: 光谱流式细胞术（蛋白水平），每轮一个 AnnData

scale_reported_zh: 约 60 GB 的原始各轮文件（仅 loop 0 就有 36 GB）；500k（50 万）细胞的子样本；4.7 GB 的衍生输入；13 GB 仅用于推理的检查点；约 1.07 million（107 万）个未过滤的设计；摘要报告了 78-million-cell（7,800 万个细胞）的数据集

perturbation_type_zh: 原代人 CD34+ 培养上的细胞因子和小分子方案

name: Response-eQTL cultures with nicotine, caffeine and ethanol
modality_zh: 干细胞衍生培养物的单细胞 RNA-seq
scale_reported_en: 51 individuals; about 1.4 million cells; 31 to 110 response eQTLs per cell type and 380, 336 and 276 eGenes per condition (these two counts are unconfirmed; Q126, Q127)
scale_reported_zh: 51 名个体；约 1.4 million（140 万）个细胞；每种细胞类型 31 至 110 个响应 eQTL，每种条件 380、336 和 276 个 eGene（这两项计数未经确认；Q126、Q127）
genotype_info_zh: 有基因型（响应 eQTL 定位）
relevance_en: G track: genotype-by-treatment single-cell data at tens of individuals; the interaction is regulatory, sparse and cell-type specific
relevance_zh: G 轨道：数十个个体规模的基因型×处理单细胞数据；交互是调控性的、稀疏的、细胞类型特异的
caveats_en: A 2026 review gives 53 individuals while the paper reports 51; data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 2026 年的一篇综述给出 53 名个体，而论文报告 51 名；数据获取方式未核查。

name: Influenza-exposed PBMCs from 90 individuals
modality_zh: 单细胞 RNA-seq 加 DNA 测序
scale_reported_en: 90 individuals; influenza A virus or mock for 6 hours
scale_reported_zh: 90 名个体；甲型流感病毒或对照处理 6 小时
relevance_en: G track: genotype-by-stimulus effects at single-cell resolution; cell-type specific and largely cis-regulatory
relevance_zh: G 轨道：单细胞分辨率的基因型×刺激效应；细胞类型特异且大部分为 cis 调控
caveats_en: The stimulus is a virus, not a drug; data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 刺激物是病毒而不是药物；数据获取方式未核查。

name: Village-in-a-dish hiPSC lines (104-donor village)
modality_en: single-cell RNA-seq of pooled hiPSC lines demultiplexed by genotype
modality_zh: 按基因型解复用的混池 hiPSC 细胞系的单细胞 RNA-seq
scale_reported_en: 104 donors; 86,185 cells
perturbation_type_en: none reported in the retrieved text (culture design)
perturbation_type_zh: 取回的文字中未报告（培养设计）
genotype_info_zh: 对混池细胞系按基因型解复用
relevance_en: G track: low-cost route to donor-by-perturbation designs
relevance_zh: G 轨道：实现供体×扰动设计的低成本途径
caveats_en: Pooled composition shifts between village and uni-culture and cross-line signalling can confound drug responses; no drug arm in the retrieved text.
caveats_zh: 村落与单独培养之间混池构成会变化，细胞系间信号可能混杂药物响应；检索到的文字中没有药物处理组。

name: MIX-Seq pooled cell lines
modality_en: single-cell RNA-seq of pooled cell lines demultiplexed by genotype
modality_zh: 按基因型解复用的混池细胞系的单细胞 RNA-seq
scale_reported_en: pool including 7 TP53 wild-type lines; total scale not retrieved
scale_reported_zh: 混池中包含 7 个 TP53 野生型细胞系；总规模未取得
perturbation_type_en: drug treatments (compounds not itemized in the retrieved text)
perturbation_type_zh: 药物处理（取回的文字中未逐一列出化合物）
genotype_info_zh: 按基因型解复用得到细胞系身份
relevance_en: S track: a variant switches a drug-induced programme off (TP53)
relevance_zh: S 轨道：变异把药物诱导的程序关闭（TP53）
caveats_en: Compound and pool size not retrieved; the claim that response signatures predict viability is from the preprint.
caveats_zh: 化合物和混池规模未取得；响应特征可预测活力这一说法来自预印本。

name: MCF10A isogenic mutant panel with 90 compounds
scale_reported_en: 51 stable lines; 90 compounds
scale_reported_zh: 51 个稳定细胞系；90 种化合物
genotype_info_en: engineered wild-type or mutant cancer genes in one background
genotype_info_zh: 在单一背景中工程化表达的野生型或突变型癌基因
relevance_en: S track: gene-variant-by-drug interaction labels without lineage confounding
relevance_zh: S 轨道：没有谱系混杂的基因变异×药物交互标签
caveats_en: The readout is proliferation, not transcription.
caveats_zh: 读出是增殖，而不是转录。

name: Caffeine reporter-assay variants in vascular endothelial cells
modality_zh: 大规模并行报告基因实验（没有转录组）
scale_reported_en: more than 43,000 variants tested; 665 with allelic effects; 6 interacting with caffeine (FDR below 5%)
scale_reported_zh: 检测了 43,000 多个变异；665 个有等位基因效应；6 个与咖啡因发生交互（FDR 低于 5%）
relevance_en: G track: direct count of regulatory-variant-by-drug interaction (about 1% of allelic variants at FDR below 5%, depending on version and threshold)
relevance_zh: G 轨道：对调控变异×药物交互的直接计数（FDR 低于 5% 时约占等位基因变异的 1%，取决于版本和阈值）
caveats_en: Reporter assay, not endogenous expression; one drug and one cell type. The first version of the paper reported 29 interacting variants at FDR below 10% (Q128).
caveats_zh: 报告基因实验，而不是内源表达；只有一种药物和一种细胞类型。论文第一版在 FDR 低于 10% 时报告了 29 个发生交互的变异（Q128）。

name: CRISPR-drug perturbational map (18 cell lines, 8 drugs)
modality_en: pooled CRISPR knockout screens with growth readout (no transcriptome)
modality_zh: 以生长为读出的混池 CRISPR 敲除筛选（没有转录组）
scale_reported_en: 18 cell lines; 8 drugs; knockouts of druggable genes
scale_reported_zh: 18 个细胞系；8 种药物；可成药基因的敲除
relevance_en: S track: labels for which pathway-gene losses sensitize to which drugs (a class-4 analogue)
relevance_zh: S 轨道：哪些通路基因缺失使细胞对哪些药物敏化的标签（类别 4 的类比）
caveats_en: The readout is pooled growth; no transcriptome.
caveats_zh: 读出是混池生长；没有转录组。
